title: Crownless: small conversations
authorship: Assistant-written dialogue drafts based on recorded simulation accounts.
scope: The account is recorded. The meeting, listener, questions, hopes, and reactions are authored for this review. Each first speaker holds the account; the listener learns it through the exchange.

scenes.title: Bread at Gloamgate
scenes.account: Gloamgate's bakery mills 25 Wheat into 25 Bread.
scenes.intent: The listener takes an interest in the bread.

lines: Gloamgate has made bread from its wheat.
I wonder what the loaves are like.
You could ask at the bakery.
They’ve baked bread at Gloamgate.
Wheat bread?
Yes.
That sounds good.

scenes.title: Waiting for stone
scenes.account: Gloamgate defers public masonry repairs for want of 2 Stone.
scenes.intent: The listener wants to understand a delay.

lines: I hear Gloamgate’s public repairs are waiting for stone.
Are the masons short of it?
That’s the word going round.
People say the repairs at Gloamgate have had to wait.
What’s holding them up?
Stone. They’re short of stone.
A hard thing to mend with empty hands.

scenes.title: A poor harvest
scenes.account: Thornford's drought harvest cannot supply the southern settlements.
scenes.intent: The listener asks what the harvest means for seed supplies.

lines: Thornford’s harvest may have fallen short of what the southern settlements need.
What about seed for next year?
I only heard about the harvest.
There’s talk of a poor harvest at Thornford. Too little for the settlements to the south.
Seed grain too?
I’d have to ask.
I hope they’ve kept some back.

scenes.title: Lamma joins the Pennants
scenes.account: Lamma Stonehewer joins The Broken Pennants after 3 days seeking food at Silverwick.
scenes.intent: The listener responds to the hardship behind the news.

lines: Lamma Stonehewer joined the Broken Pennants after looking for food at Silverwick.
For how long?
Days.
That’s a long time to be hungry.
Lamma Stonehewer has joined the Broken Pennants.
What happened?
Lamma had spent days looking for food at Silverwick.
I wish someone had found a meal for Lamma.

scenes.title: A goblin becomes Voice
scenes.account: A goblin rises to Voice in the dragon cult through service.
scenes.intent: The listener is curious about a promotion. Both speakers are unnamed; their species is unspecified.

lines: I hear a goblin has risen to Voice in the dragon cult.
Through service?
So people say.
I wonder what the work was.
There’s talk of a goblin being made Voice in the dragon cult.
Someone earned a place, then?
Through service, I hear.
I’d like to hear their story.

scenes.title: A treasure taken
scenes.account: The Cinder Tithe raids Rosespire: 16 Bread, 16 crowns, and a named treasure.
scenes.intent: The listener asks about an uncertain report of a raid.

lines: The Cinder Tithe may have raided Rosespire. I heard they took bread, crowns, and a treasure.
Which treasure?
I only heard that there was one.
Have you heard the story about the Cinder Tithe at Rosespire?
What story?
A raid. Bread and crowns taken, and a treasure too, perhaps.
Do you know what it was?
I’d have to ask.

scenes.title: Calves at Rosespire
scenes.account: Rosespire's cattle herd raises 1 new calf; 1 older calf join the working herd.
scenes.intent: The listener distinguishes a new calf from an older animal joining the herd.

lines: Rosespire has raised a new calf. An older calf has joined the working herd too.
The little one has some growing to do.
Yes. The older one is ready.
There’s a new calf at Rosespire.
And more cattle for the working herd?
An older calf has joined it.
Good to hear the older one is ready.

scenes.title: Stone from Silverwick
scenes.account: Silverwick's quarry cuts 12 Stone for roads and public works.
scenes.intent: The listener asks what quarried stone is intended for.

lines: I hear Silverwick has cut stone for roads and public works.
For the roads as well?
That’s what I heard.
Word is there’s stone coming out of Silverwick’s quarry.
Where is it meant to go?
Roads and public works, I hear.
I’ll be glad to see it put to use.

scenes.title: The treaty bridge
scenes.account: Alderwatch closes the treaty bridge and delays the relief convoy.
scenes.intent: The listener worries about the relief convoy after hearing an uncertain report.

lines: Alderwatch may have closed the treaty bridge. The relief convoy could be held up.
Is that why it’s delayed?
That’s the story I heard.
There’s a story going round that Alderwatch shut the treaty bridge.
What about the relief convoy?
Held up, if the story is right.
I hope they can get through soon.

scenes.title: Paper from the mill
scenes.account: Rosespire's mill uses 1 Wood to make 4 Paper.
scenes.intent: The listener takes an interest in how paper was made.

lines: Rosespire’s mill has made paper from wood.
Wood into paper. That’s clever work.
They’ve made paper at Rosespire’s mill.
What did they use?
Wood.
I’d like to watch that being done.

scenes.title: The food store
scenes.account: Gloamgate has 24 food in store. Its reserve target is 75.
scenes.intent: The listener distinguishes low reserves from an empty store.

lines: People say Gloamgate has less food stored than it aims to keep.
Is there some left?
Yes, from what I hear.
Gloamgate’s food stores sound low.
How low?
There’s food left, I hear, but less than they mean to keep.
I hope more comes in soon.

scenes.title: The Ash Crown
scenes.account: Rosespire finishes Rosespire Ash Crown from 1 Raw Gold, 1 Gems, and 3 weeks of work.
scenes.intent: The listener is curious about a reported piece of craftwork.

lines: Rosespire may have finished the Ash Crown. I heard it took gold, gems, and weeks of work.
I’d like to see it.
So would I.
There’s talk that the Rosespire Ash Crown is finished.
What’s it made of?
Gold and gems, I think. They spent weeks on it, from what I heard.
I hope we get to see it.
